title: 北京—上海高速鐵路~Beijing–Shanghai high-speed railway
focus: 長大高架高速走廊沉陷與營運韌性~Long viaduct high speed corridor settlement and resilience
summary: 以北京至上海高速鐵路為背景，建立長距離橋梁、路基與多城市車站組成的教學網路。重點是把局部沉陷和橋梁撓度與高速車輛反應聯繫，同時檢查多站停靠造成的班表差異、風險監測與修復後的服務恢復。~Use Beijing–Shanghai high-speed rail to construct a teaching network of bridges, earthworks and stations in several cities. Relate local settlement and bridge deflection to vehicle response at speed. At the same time, inspect differing stopping patterns, environmental monitoring and service restoration after repair, distinguishing an average network metric from a critical local defect.
example: 整合原創算例：單元 1 得 deflection=1.146659 mm；單元 2 得 gradient=0.636 mm/m；單元 3 得 frequency=1.338745 Hz。上述三個結果使用各單元明示的不同邊界，不能任意相加或視為實際工程實測值。以第一單元 L 的擾動測試，結果改為 1.678823 mm；學徒需先比較單位、敏感度和假設，再決定是否要細化模型。以北京至上海高速鐵路為背景，建立長距離橋梁、路基與多城市車站組成的教學網路。重點是把局部沉陷和橋梁撓度與高速車輛反應聯繫，同時檢查多站停靠造成的班表差異、風險監測與修復後的服務恢復。 最終交付應保留原始輸入、測點時間戳、誤差範圍與無法由簡化式證明的結論。~Integrated original exercise: unit 1 gives deflection=1.146659 mm; unit 2 gives gradient=0.636 mm/m; unit 3 gives frequency=1.338745 Hz. These three results use different explicit boundaries and must not be added or presented as measurements of the real railway. Perturbing L in the first unit changes its result to 1.678823 mm. Compare units, sensitivity and assumptions before deciding which model needs refinement. Use Beijing–Shanghai high-speed rail to construct a teaching network of bridges, earthworks and stations in several cities. Relate local settlement and bridge deflection to vehicle response at speed. At the same time, inspect differing stopping patterns, environmental monitoring and service restoration after repair, distinguishing an average network metric from a critical local defect. The final submission should retain original inputs, measurement timestamps, uncertainty ranges and conclusions that the simplified expressions cannot establish.
history: 公開工程與出版時間線：2011 年：北京至上海高速鐵路於六月投入營運；2019 年：世界銀行發布中國高速鐵路發展研究報告。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以北京至上海高速鐵路為背景，建立長距離橋梁、路基與多城市車站組成的教學網路。重點是把局部沉陷和橋梁撓度與高速車輛反應聯繫，同時檢查多站停靠造成的班表差異、風險監測與修復後的服務恢復。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。~Public engineering and publication chronology: 2011: The Beijing–Shanghai high-speed railway entered service in June; 2019: The World Bank published its study of Chinese high-speed rail development. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use Beijing–Shanghai high-speed rail to construct a teaching network of bridges, earthworks and stations in several cities. Relate local settlement and bridge deflection to vehicle response at speed. At the same time, inspect differing stopping patterns, environmental monitoring and service restoration after repair, distinguishing an average network metric from a critical local defect. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

units.anchor: 橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度~Bridge deflection and span sensitivity
units.title: 橋梁撓度與跨長敏感度~Bridge deflection and span sensitivity
units.mechanism: 簡支梁在均布荷載下的撓度對跨長有四次方敏感度，截面慣性矩與材料剛度共同抵抗彎曲。鐵道橋還需要動態與軌道相互作用檢查，靜態梁算例只用來辨認參數量級。 跨長四次方使幾何誤差特別重要，但只有在相同支承、均布荷載及截面條件下才可比較。將毫米轉成公尺後再核對剛度，可避免把量測位移誤差變成材料性能判斷。 以跨中和支點同步位移辨識高架橋靜態剛度而非單點位移。~For a simply supported beam under uniform load, deflection scales with the fourth power of span. Section inertia and material stiffness jointly resist bending. A railway bridge also requires dynamic and track-interaction checks; this static beam exercise only reveals parameter magnitudes. Fourth-power span dependence makes geometry important, but comparison requires the same support, uniform-load and section assumptions. Convert millimetres and metres consistently before checking stiffness, so a displacement-unit error does not become a false conclusion about material properties. Identify viaduct static stiffness through simultaneous midspan and support displacement rather than one reading.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：w=50000 N/m; L=26.5 m; E=3.5e+10 Pa; I=8 m^4；計算：deflection=5*w*L**4/(384*E*I)*1000=1.146659 mm。敏感度：L 單獨增加百分之十至 29.15 m，其餘固定，結果為 1.678823 mm。模型邊界：簡支Euler梁、小撓度、靜態均布荷載；不代表列車移動荷載。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: w=50000 N/m; L=26.5 m; E=3.5e+10 Pa; I=8 m^4; calculation: deflection=5*w*L**4/(384*E*I)*1000=1.146659 mm. Sensitivity: L, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 29.15 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1.678823 mm. Model boundary: Simply supported Euler beam, small deflection and static uniform load; not a moving train-load analysis.
units.verify: 在已知載重位置量測跨中和支點位移，扣除支承沉陷後對照彎矩圖，並用卸載後讀值檢查是否存在殘留變形。 先以已知荷載校對位移計量程與零點，分別記錄載入卸載路徑及支點運動。~Measure midspan and support movement under known loading, subtract support settlement, compare with the moment diagram, and inspect residual displacement after unloading. Check displacement-sensor range and zero under known loading, recording loading and unloading paths separately from support movement.
units.failure: 支承鬆動或局部開裂可能改變有效剛度，若把所有位移都當成梁彎曲，校準出的彈性模數就會失真。 若卸載後仍有位移，須區分基座滑移與構件殘留變形。~Loose supports and local cracking alter effective stiffness; interpreting all displacement as beam bending produces a misleading calibrated elastic modulus. Residual displacement after unloading requires distinguishing fixture slip from permanent structural deformation.
units.misconception: 橋梁跨長增加一成其彈性撓度最多只增加一成~Increasing bridge span by ten percent increases elastic deflection by at most ten percent.
units.practice: 保持截面不變增加跨長，再比較提高慣性矩的補償幅度，說明靜態位移符合預期為何仍不能取代動態驗證。 再以本單元 L 的對照值重算 deflection，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Increase span while keeping the section fixed, calculate the compensating inertia change, and explain why agreement in static deflection cannot replace dynamic verification. Also recalculate deflection for the alternative L value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 沉陷差與軌道坡折~Differential settlement and track kink
units.title: 沉陷差與軌道坡折~Differential settlement and track kink
units.mechanism: 均勻沉陷主要改變高程，短距離差異沉陷則改變軌道坡度和車輪動態荷載。兩端高差除以基長只給平均坡度，無法描述局部尖峰；需要多點剖面才能辨認曲率與變形長度。 相同端點坡度可以對應完全不同的中間形狀，因此坡度不能單獨表示軌道曲率。測點間距必須小於欲辨認的變形尺度，並將高程誤差相對於基長傳遞到坡度結果。 對橋路過渡區畫出多點沉陷槽，檢查短基長坡折。~Uniform settlement mainly changes elevation, whereas differential settlement over a short distance alters track slope and dynamic wheel loading. End-to-end difference divided by baseline gives only an average gradient, not a local peak. A spatial profile is needed to identify curvature and deformation length. Identical endpoint gradient can hide very different intermediate shapes, so gradient alone cannot describe track curvature. Survey spacing must resolve the deformation length scale, and elevation uncertainty must be propagated relative to the baseline into the reported gradient. Plot a multipoint settlement trough at a bridge-earthwork transition and inspect short-baseline kinks.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：drop=0.01272 m; baseline=20 m；計算：gradient=1000*drop/baseline=0.636 mm/m。敏感度：drop 單獨增加百分之十至 0.013992 m，其餘固定，結果為 0.6996 mm/m。模型邊界：小變形平均坡度；不計車軌耦合動力或容許軌道幾何。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: drop=0.01272 m; baseline=20 m; calculation: gradient=1000*drop/baseline=0.636 mm/m. Sensitivity: drop, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.013992 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.6996 mm/m. Model boundary: Small-deformation average gradient; vehicle-track dynamics and permissible geometry limits are excluded.
units.verify: 採用同一穩定水準基點反覆量測，保留溫度和施工時間，利用多點高程剖面區分整段平移、坡折與量測基點漂移。 重複觀測同一測點並做閉合檢核，以另一穩定基準核對零點，報告高差與基長各自誤差。~Repeat surveys against one stable datum, retain temperature and construction timing, and use multipoint profiles to separate translation, kinks and datum drift. Repeat identical points with closure checks, verify zero against another stable reference, and report separate errors for elevation difference and baseline.
units.failure: 基點本身下沉會讓全段看似正常；只量端點又會漏掉中間沉陷槽，兩種情況均可低估輪軌衝擊。 高差異常需先查基點，不能立刻推定路基局部下沉。~A settling datum can hide movement of the whole section, and endpoint-only measurement misses an intermediate trough; both may understate wheel-rail impact. An unusual level difference requires a datum check before inferring local earthwork settlement.
units.misconception: 兩端高程相同就能證明兩點之間沒有差異沉陷~Equal endpoint elevations prove there is no differential settlement between them.
units.practice: 構造端點相同但中間下陷的剖面，與直線坡度模型比較；提出足以辨識沉陷槽寬度的測點間距與複測頻率。 再以本單元 drop 的對照值重算 gradient，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Construct a profile with equal endpoints and an intermediate trough, compare it with a straight-gradient model, and propose spacing and repeat intervals able to resolve the trough. Also recalculate gradient for the alternative drop value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 懸吊固有頻率與激振~Suspension frequency and excitation
units.title: 懸吊固有頻率與激振~Suspension frequency and excitation
units.mechanism: 彈簧與質量的組合決定垂向固有頻率，增加質量降低頻率而提高剛度使頻率升高。軌道不平順被車速轉換成時間激振；因此相同軌道波長在不同速度下可能接近或遠離共振。 固有頻率和振幅不是同一資訊，阻尼主要影響峰值和衰減。空車與滿載質量不同時，軌道某一波長可能落在不同激振頻率比，應同時考慮速度與載重。 把軌道變形波長轉成列車所見激振頻率。~Spring stiffness and supported mass determine vertical natural frequency. Added mass lowers frequency, while increased stiffness raises it. Train speed converts spatial track irregularity into temporal excitation, so the same wavelength may approach or leave resonance as speed changes. Natural frequency and amplitude contain different information; damping primarily affects peaks and decay. Empty and loaded masses can place one track wavelength at different excitation-frequency ratios. Speed and loading therefore need to be considered together. Convert track-deformation wavelength into the excitation frequency experienced by a moving train.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：k=900000 N/m; mass=12720 kg；計算：frequency=(k/mass)**0.5/(2*3.141592653589793)=1.338745 Hz。敏感度：mass 單獨增加百分之十至 13992 kg，其餘固定，結果為 1.276443 Hz。模型邊界：單自由度無阻尼模型；不含俯仰、側滾與輪軌接觸。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: k=900000 N/m; mass=12720 kg; calculation: frequency=(k/mass)**0.5/(2*3.141592653589793)=1.338745 Hz. Sensitivity: mass, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 13992 kg, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1.276443 Hz. Model boundary: Undamped single-degree-of-freedom model; pitch, roll and wheel-rail contact are excluded.
units.verify: 量測已知質量下的自由衰減與頻率響應，對照不同載客狀態；同步記錄軌道波長和速度，避免混淆激振頻率與固有頻率。 由自由衰減同時辨識頻率及衰減率，檢查感測器是否位於同一振型的有效位置。~Measure free decay and frequency response at known mass, repeat for different passenger loading, and log track wavelength and speed to distinguish excitation from natural frequency. Identify frequency and decay rate together from free decay, and verify that sensors occupy useful positions for the same vibration mode.
units.failure: 只調剛度追求低頻隔振可能增加行程需求；阻尼器失效可能保持固有頻率近似不變，卻大幅增加共振振幅。 需量測衰減率，不能以峰值頻率不變排除阻尼故障。~Softening springs for low-frequency isolation increases travel demand; a failed damper may barely change natural frequency while greatly increasing resonant amplitude. Measure decay rate; an unchanged peak frequency cannot exclude a damping fault.
units.misconception: 量到固有頻率不變就能證明阻尼器沒有劣化~An unchanged natural frequency proves that the damper has not deteriorated.
units.practice: 比較空車與滿載頻率，計算一個指定波長對應的激振速度，並列出阻尼與行程限制對判斷的影響。 再以本單元 mass 的對照值重算 frequency，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Compare empty and loaded frequencies, calculate the speed corresponding to one irregularity wavelength, and explain the influence of damping and suspension travel limits. Also recalculate frequency for the alternative mass value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 曲線超高與未平衡加速度~Cant and unbalanced acceleration
units.title: 曲線超高與未平衡加速度~Cant and unbalanced acceleration
units.mechanism: 曲線需求的向心加速度由重力沿軌道平面的分量與輪軌側向作用共同提供。超高平衡速度只對特定半徑和速度成立，慢車可能出現超高過剩；不能把增加超高當成所有車種都受益的措施。 殘餘加速度的正負表示側向作用方向，而不是安全與危險的二元判斷。半徑、軌距與高差必須使用一致長度單位，車體感受還會受到懸吊轉角影響。 比較不同速度等級服務通過同一曲線時的超高需求。~On a curve, the component of gravity in the track plane and wheel-rail lateral forces together provide centripetal acceleration. Equilibrium cant applies to one radius and speed. A slower service can experience cant excess, so increasing cant does not improve every train condition. The sign of residual acceleration identifies its lateral direction, not a binary safe-unsafe outcome. Radius, gauge and rail-level difference require consistent length units. Carbody response is additionally affected by suspension rotation, which this geometric estimate does not resolve. Compare cant demand when services of different speed classes pass through one curve.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=63.6 m/s; R=4000 m; gauge=1.5 m; cant=0.12 m；計算：residual=v*v/R-9.81*cant/gauge=0.22644 m/s^2。敏感度：v 單獨增加百分之十至 69.96 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 0.4388004 m/s^2。模型邊界：小角度近似與剛性車體；未計懸吊側滾、動態輪重減載和規範允收值。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: v=63.6 m/s; R=4000 m; gauge=1.5 m; cant=0.12 m; calculation: residual=v*v/R-9.81*cant/gauge=0.22644 m/s^2. Sensitivity: v, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 69.96 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.4388004 m/s^2. Model boundary: Small-angle approximation and rigid body; suspension roll, dynamic wheel unloading and acceptance limits are excluded.
units.verify: 在相同半徑區段量測軌面高差與橫向加速度，扣除感測器安裝角度，並把車體讀值與軌道平面讀值分開記錄。 用實測半徑和高差重算平衡速度，保留感測器安裝角的校正值及量測不確定度。~Measure rail level difference and lateral acceleration on the same curve, remove sensor mounting angle, and distinguish carbody readings from track-plane readings. Recalculate equilibrium speed from measured radius and cant, retaining mounting-angle corrections and uncertainty for the acceleration sensor.
units.failure: 只依高速通過最佳化超高，可能讓慢車或停車承受反向側向力；感測器橫滾又會把重力投影混入振動訊號。 需核對高差符號與曲線方向，防止左右軌互換。~Cant optimised only for fast trains can impose reverse lateral loading on slow or stopped trains; sensor roll also mixes gravity into vibration measurements. Check cant sign against curve direction to prevent swapping the inner and outer rails.
units.misconception: 任何速度下增加超高都一定減少車內橫向加速度~Increasing cant always reduces lateral acceleration at every operating speed.
units.practice: 選兩種速度共同計算殘餘加速度，找出符號反轉位置，說明為何混合服務需要速度分布而非單一最高速度。 再以本單元 v 的對照值重算 residual，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Calculate residual acceleration for two speeds, locate its sign reversal, and explain why mixed services require a speed distribution rather than one maximum speed. Also recalculate residual for the alternative v value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 側風力與翻覆力矩~Crosswind force and overturning moment
units.title: 側風力與翻覆力矩~Crosswind force and overturning moment
units.mechanism: 側風作用可由動壓乘有效側向面積估算，再乘作用高度形成翻覆力矩。車輛質量、重心、風向及橋面遮蔽同時影響輪重分配，單一靜態力矩只能提供比較而非營運風速門檻。 橫向力依側風分量平方變化，列車姿態和地形會改變受風面積及係數。此力尺度不直接給出傾覆門檻；還需重心、輪重減載、懸吊和陣風時間歷程。 在高架開闊段使用陣風而非日平均風速檢查側向力尺度。~Crosswind force can be estimated from dynamic pressure and effective lateral area, then multiplied by application height for an overturning moment. Mass, centre of gravity, wind direction and shielding affect wheel loading together; one static moment only supports comparison, not an operational wind threshold. Lateral force varies with squared crosswind component, while vehicle attitude and terrain change exposed area and coefficients. The force scale does not directly yield an overturning threshold; centre of gravity, wheel unloading, suspension and gust history remain necessary. Use gusts rather than daily mean wind to inspect the lateral-force scale on an exposed viaduct.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1.2 kg/m^3; wind=26.5 m/s; side_area=90 m^2; coefficient=1 1; height=2 m；計算：moment=0.5*rho*wind**2*side_area*coefficient*height/1000=75.843 kN*m。敏感度：wind 單獨增加百分之十至 29.15 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 91.77003 kN*m。模型邊界：定常橫風與已假設氣動係數；不含陣風、列車運動與動態輪重減載。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: rho=1.2 kg/m^3; wind=26.5 m/s; side_area=90 m^2; coefficient=1 1; height=2 m; calculation: moment=0.5*rho*wind**2*side_area*coefficient*height/1000=75.843 kN*m. Sensitivity: wind, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 29.15 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 91.77003 kN*m. Model boundary: Steady crosswind and assumed aerodynamic coefficient; gusts, train motion and dynamic unloading are excluded.
units.verify: 同步記錄沿線風速、風向、列車速度及車體側滾，檢查風速站是否受地形遮蔽，再用多點資料評估代表性。 核對風速計高度與方向，保存陣風時序，將列車姿態與側向加速度放在同一時間軸。~Synchronise wind speed, direction, train speed and carbody roll, inspect terrain shielding at the anemometer, and assess representativeness with multiple locations. Verify anemometer height and orientation, retain gust histories, and align vehicle attitude with lateral acceleration on one timeline.
units.failure: 受遮蔽的風速計可能低估橋上曝露，空載與滿載車又具有不同抗翻覆力矩；不能只用最近測站單一讀值。 日平均風速會掩蓋陣風，需檢查量測平均時間與峰值。~A sheltered anemometer can understate exposure on a viaduct, and empty versus loaded vehicles have different restoring moments; the nearest sensor alone is insufficient. Daily mean wind hides gusts; inspect averaging duration and the recorded peaks.
units.misconception: 側風翻覆力矩只和風速成正比而不涉及車體高度~Crosswind overturning moment is linear in wind speed and independent of vehicle height.
units.practice: 把風速與作用高度各增加一成，對比力矩敏感度，提出能區分地形加速與儀器誤差的多點量測配置。 再以本單元 wind 的對照值重算 moment，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Increase wind speed and load height separately by ten percent, compare moment sensitivity, and propose measurements distinguishing terrain acceleration from instrument error. Also recalculate moment for the alternative wind value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 快慢車追及與待避~Fast-slow train catch-up
units.title: 快慢車追及與待避~Fast-slow train catch-up
units.mechanism: 快車在同一路段追上慢車的時間取決於初始間距除相對速度。這個簡單關係能辨認待避需求，但實際時刻表還需加入停站、進路鎖閉與加減速；追及點不是允許兩車接近的安全距離。 追趕時間取決於起始間隔和兩列相對速度，不能只看快車速度。若兩列會停站或受訊號限制，速度必須改成分段函數，並把進路占用放回事件圖。 用多城市停站模式建立快慢列車的追趕時間圖。~Catch-up time on a shared section is initial separation divided by relative speed. This relation identifies the need for overtaking opportunities, but real timetables also include stops, route locking and acceleration. The meeting point is not a permitted safe separation between trains. Catch-up time depends on starting separation and relative speed, not only the faster train’s speed. If either train stops or encounters signalling constraints, use piecewise speed functions and restore route occupation to the event diagram. Construct a catch-up timeline for fast and slow services with different city stopping patterns.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：gap=12720 m; fast=60 m/s; slow=40 m/s；計算：catch_time=gap/(fast-slow)=636 s。敏感度：gap 單獨增加百分之十至 13992 m，其餘固定，結果為 699.6 s。模型邊界：同向恆速且快車較快；不含號誌保護和停站。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: gap=12720 m; fast=60 m/s; slow=40 m/s; calculation: catch_time=gap/(fast-slow)=636 s. Sensitivity: gap, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 13992 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 699.6 s. Model boundary: Same-direction constant speeds with a faster following train; signalling protection and stops are excluded.
units.verify: 用列車運行圖標出快慢車路徑與停站，把相交位置對照可待避地點，並核對道岔與站台實際占用時間。 以逐站到發時刻重建距離時間圖，核對起始間隔和各段速度，並標示待避占用。~Plot fast and slow trajectories including stops, compare intersections with overtaking locations, and verify actual point and platform occupation times. Rebuild a distance-time diagram from station arrivals and departures, verifying initial separation and segment speeds and marking passing occupation.
units.failure: 只看區間平均速度可能把追及位置判錯；慢車停站時間波動會改變待避窗口並將延誤傳給快車。 快慢車速度相同時不能用追趕公式分母，須重設工況。~Using section-average speed can misplace the catch-up location; variable stopping time shifts overtaking windows and passes delay to the fast train. Equal train speeds invalidate the catch-up denominator; redefine the operating case.
units.misconception: 快慢車平均速度不同也不會影響同線時刻表容量~Different fast and slow train speeds do not affect shared-line timetable capacity.
units.practice: 增加慢車停站與快車出發延後各一個情境，畫出時空圖，討論待避線能解決的衝突與仍存在的交叉進路限制。 再以本單元 gap 的對照值重算 catch_time，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Add a slow-train stop and a delayed fast departure as separate cases, draw time-distance diagrams, and distinguish conflicts solved by a loop from remaining crossing-route restrictions. Also recalculate catch_time for the alternative gap value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 班距與有效運能~Headway and usable capacity
units.title: 班距與有效運能~Headway and usable capacity
units.mechanism: 每小時運能由列車可用容量與通過頻率共同決定，平均班距縮短不代表每個車站都能吸收人流。車門交換、轉乘尖峰與不均勻到站會讓理論運能無法實現，容量計算應同時報告負載分布。 此式計算的是通過指定斷面的名目服務率，不能表示月台能容納多少人。需求在空間或時間上集中時，某站可以過載，即使整條線的平均載客率仍低。 把跨區長途客流與短途區間客流分開計算滿載位置。~Hourly capacity combines usable train capacity with passage frequency. A shorter average headway does not ensure every station can absorb the passenger flow. Door exchange, transfer surges and irregular arrivals can prevent the theoretical rate from being realised, so occupancy distribution must accompany the capacity estimate. This expression estimates a nominal service rate across a specified section, not how many people a platform can hold. Concentrated demand can overload one station even when average occupancy across the complete line remains relatively low. Separate interregional and shorter-distance demand when locating the most heavily loaded section.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=900 persons/train; headway=190.8 s/train；計算：capacity=3600*people/headway=16981.13 persons/hour。敏感度：headway 單獨增加百分之十至 209.88 s/train，其餘固定，結果為 15437.39 persons/hour。模型邊界：固定班距且每列都能使用指定容量；不包含站台壅塞及服務波動。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: people=900 persons/train; headway=190.8 s/train; calculation: capacity=3600*people/headway=16981.13 persons/hour. Sensitivity: headway, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 209.88 s/train, with all other inputs fixed, gives 15437.39 persons/hour. Model boundary: Fixed headway with the stated usable capacity on every train; platform congestion and service variability are excluded.
units.verify: 以連續列車的實際到站時間與逐車廂乘載量重算，將未登車人數保留在隊列，不以列車額定容量代替實際服務量。 逐列核對上車、下車與留下人數的守恆，並以同一計數時間窗比較需求和服務量。~Recalculate from consecutive arrival times and individual car loads. Carry passengers unable to board into the queue instead of treating rated capacity as delivered service. Check conservation of boarding, alighting and remaining passengers for every train, using identical counting windows for demand and delivered service.
units.failure: 某一列延誤會使後車追近而前方隊列累積；只看小時平均會漏掉最擁擠列車與長等待尾端。 應查驗未登車隊列，避免把滿載通過當成需求已服務。~A delayed train lets following trains bunch while the upstream queue grows; an hourly mean hides both the fullest train and the long-wait tail. Inspect passengers left behind instead of interpreting a full passing train as demand served.
units.misconception: 只要平均班距減半所有乘客的等待時間就一定減半~Halving average headway necessarily halves the waiting time of every passenger.
units.practice: 用一組規則班距與一組相同平均值的不規則班距，追蹤每班留下的人數，解釋理論容量與可用容量的差距。 再以本單元 headway 的對照值重算 capacity，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Compare regular and irregular headways with the same mean, track passengers left behind after each departure, and explain the gap between theoretical and usable capacity. Also recalculate capacity for the alternative headway value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 重複荷載與線性損傷帳~Repeated loading and linear damage account
units.title: 重複荷載與線性損傷帳~Repeated loading and linear damage account
units.mechanism: 疲勞取決於應力範圍與循環次數，線性累積把各級循環數除以對應壽命後相加。此帳務能比較荷載譜，卻忽略順序效應、腐蝕與裂紋成長，損傷和為一不是對任何構件的通用失效保證。 線性累積損傷不保留載重順序，也不能自行描述腐蝕、裂紋閉合和超載效應。疲勞曲線的適用材料與應力定義必須一致，否則算出的壽命比例沒有可比性。 分組計算不同車型與載重循環的損傷貢獻。~Fatigue depends on stress range and cycle count. Linear accumulation sums the fraction of life consumed at each level. This accounting compares load spectra but omits sequence effects, corrosion and crack growth; a sum of one is not a universal failure guarantee for every component. Linear cumulative damage does not retain load order and cannot independently describe corrosion, crack closure or overload effects. The fatigue curve must match the material and stress definition; otherwise calculated life fractions are not comparable. Group damage contributions from different train types and load cycles.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：n1=212000 cycles; N1=1000000 cycles; n2=50000 cycles; N2=250000 cycles；計算：damage_index=n1/N1+n2/N2=0.412 1。敏感度：n1 將整數計數增加到 233201至 233201 cycles，其餘固定，結果為 0.433201 1。模型邊界：兩級循環的Miner帳務且壽命輸入已假設；不外推真實剩餘壽命。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: n1=212000 cycles; N1=1000000 cycles; n2=50000 cycles; N2=250000 cycles; calculation: damage_index=n1/N1+n2/N2=0.412 1. Sensitivity: n1, increase the integer count to 233201, to 233201 cycles, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.433201 1. Model boundary: Two-level Miner accounting with assumed life values; no real residual-life prediction is made.
units.verify: 以雨流計數整理應變歷程，核對儀器零漂與列車通過事件，保留應力轉換和材料曲線的來源與適用範圍。 從原始應變檢查應力換算與循環計數，核對各級距的次數總和及疲勞曲線來源。~Count strain histories using rainflow analysis, check sensor drift against train passages, and retain the source and applicability of stress conversion and material curves. Check stress conversion and cycle counting from raw strain, verifying total counts across bins and the source of the fatigue curve.
units.failure: 漏記少量大應力循環可能比漏記大量小循環更嚴重；焊趾局部應力也不能直接由遠處名義應變代表。 若應力級距漏計，累積損傷偏低不能證明構件仍完好。~Missing a few large cycles can matter more than missing many small ones; nominal strain away from a weld cannot directly represent local weld-toe stress. Understated damage caused by omitted stress bins is not evidence that the component remains sound.
units.misconception: 疲勞損傷只取決於通過列車總數而不受應力幅影響~Fatigue damage depends only on train count and is independent of stress range.
units.practice: 保持總循環數不變，將部分低應力循環移到高應力級，重算損傷帳並說明需要何種檢測來支持剩餘壽命判讀。 再以本單元 n1 的對照值重算 damage_index，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Keep total cycles fixed while moving some cycles to the higher-stress level, recalculate damage, and identify inspections needed to support any remaining-life interpretation. Also recalculate damage_index for the alternative n1 value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 控制網與獨立量測殘差~Survey control and independent residuals
units.title: 控制網與獨立量測殘差~Survey control and independent residuals
units.mechanism: 兩套獨立量測可用座標差的平方和開根號描述平面殘差，但這只是對照量而不是絕對準確度。共同基點錯誤會同時影響兩套結果，控制網需要閉合檢查及外部基準才能發現系統偏差。 兩座標差的歐氏長度表示平面殘差大小，不是隨機標準差。先把兩套座標轉到相同基準和單位，再檢查各方向偏差；共同平移可能讓相對殘差很小但絕對位置仍錯。 對連續水準測量做閉合檢核，辨認基準點漂移。~The root-sum-square of coordinate differences describes planar residual between independent measurements, not absolute accuracy. A shared control-point error affects both results. Network closure and an external datum are needed to reveal systematic bias that agreement alone can conceal. The Euclidean length of two coordinate differences measures planar residual, not random standard deviation. Transform both coordinate sets to one datum and unit before inspecting directional differences. Common translation can leave a small relative residual while absolute position remains wrong. Perform closure checks on repeated levelling and identify datum movement.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：dx=0.00318 m; dy=0.004 m；計算：residual=(dx*dx+dy*dy)**0.5*1000=5.110029 mm。敏感度：dx 單獨增加百分之十至 0.003498 m，其餘固定，結果為 5.313756 mm。模型邊界：平面兩分量殘差；不含座標轉換協方差和垂直誤差。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: dx=0.00318 m; dy=0.004 m; calculation: residual=(dx*dx+dy*dy)**0.5*1000=5.110029 mm. Sensitivity: dx, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.003498 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 5.313756 mm. Model boundary: Planar two-component residual; transformation covariance and vertical error are excluded.
units.verify: 用獨立控制點做閉合觀測，記錄儀器溫度、氣壓改正與視線長度，將重複性和系統偏差分開報告。 以反向觀測、閉合路線和外部基準交叉檢核，分開報告平面殘差與可疑共同偏差。~Close observations on independent controls, record instrument temperature, pressure correction and sight length, and report repeatability separately from systematic bias. Cross-check reversed observations, closed loops and external references, reporting planar residual separately from suspected shared bias.
units.failure: 同一錯誤基點會讓兩台儀器一致偏移；長視線折光與站體熱變形也可能被誤認為施工偏差。 閉合良好仍可能全部同向漂移，須使用外部穩定基準。~One wrong datum can shift both instruments consistently; long-sight refraction and thermal movement can also be mistaken for construction error. Good closure can coexist with common drift; an external stable reference remains necessary.
units.misconception: 兩台儀器量得同樣座標就證明座標絕對正確~Matching coordinates from two instruments prove absolute coordinate accuracy.
units.practice: 加入一個共同平移偏差，檢查兩儀器殘差與外部基準差異，提出能辨識系統誤差的控制網配置。 再以本單元 dx 的對照值重算 residual，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Add a shared translation bias, compare inter-instrument residual with error to an external datum, and propose a control network that can reveal systematic error. Also recalculate residual for the alternative dx value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 並聯備援與共同原因~Parallel redundancy and common cause
units.title: 並聯備援與共同原因~Parallel redundancy and common cause
units.mechanism: 兩個獨立元件只要有一個成功即可服務時，系統失效機率等於兩者失效機率相乘。但共用電源、軟體或環境會破壞獨立假設，備援數量增加不能自動證明整體風險按平方下降。 獨立失效機率相乘只在共同原因可忽略時成立。共用機房、電源、時鐘或軟體缺陷會使冗餘失去預期效果；應把獨立事件與共同事件分成不同邏輯項。 檢查環境監測與通訊設備是否共享會同時失效的電源。~When either of two independent components can serve the demand, system failure probability is the product of their failure probabilities. Shared power, software or environment breaks independence. More redundant components therefore do not automatically prove a squared reduction in overall risk. Multiplying failure probabilities requires negligible common causes. Shared rooms, power, clocks or software defects can defeat expected redundancy. Represent independent events and common events as separate logical terms rather than silently combining them. Check whether environmental monitoring and communication equipment share a common failing power source.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：q1=0.0212 1; q2=0.03 1；計算：joint_failure=q1*q2=0.000636 1。敏感度：q1 單獨增加百分之十至 0.02332 1，其餘固定，結果為 0.0006996 1。模型邊界：同一時間窗內獨立失效且切換完美；不含共同原因與切換失敗。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: q1=0.0212 1; q2=0.03 1; calculation: joint_failure=q1*q2=0.000636 1. Sensitivity: q1, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.02332 1, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.0006996 1. Model boundary: Independent failures in one time window with perfect switching; common causes and switch failure are excluded.
units.verify: 畫出供電、網路、冷卻和軟體版本的依賴圖，逐一驗證切換功能；以故障注入確認另一通道可承接完整需求。 列出兩通道共用的實體與軟體資源，分開注入單路故障及共因故障，核對失效狀態。~Map dependencies in power, networking, cooling and software versions, verify switching, and use fault injection to confirm the surviving channel can carry the full demand. List physical and software resources shared by both channels, inject individual and common-cause faults separately, and verify resulting failure states.
units.failure: 兩台設備接在同一配電盤可能被一次故障同時切斷；過載備援也可能在接手後立即失效。 兩個盒子不等於兩個獨立通道，須核對共用依賴。~Two devices on one distribution board can be lost together, and an undersized backup can fail immediately after taking over. Two boxes do not imply two independent channels; inspect their shared dependencies.
units.misconception: 只要設備數量變成兩台失效機率就必定平方降低~Doubling equipment count necessarily squares down the failure probability.
units.practice: 在獨立模型加入一個共同原因機率，對比結果，列出可用物理隔離與不同依賴路徑降低的風險。 再以本單元 q1 的對照值重算 joint_failure，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Add one common-cause probability to the independent model, compare the result, and identify risks reduced by physical separation and distinct dependencies. Also recalculate joint_failure for the alternative q1 value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

教學假設，單元 2：drop=0.01272 m，計算 gradient=0.636 mm/m；非實測性能。~Teaching assumption, unit 2: drop=0.01272 m, calculated gradient=0.636 mm/m; not measured performance.
教學假設，單元 3：mass=12720 kg，計算 frequency=1.338745 Hz；非實測性能。~Teaching assumption, unit 3: mass=12720 kg, calculated frequency=1.338745 Hz; not measured performance.
教學假設，單元 4：v=63.6 m/s，計算 residual=0.22644 m/s^2；非實測性能。~Teaching assumption, unit 4: v=63.6 m/s, calculated residual=0.22644 m/s^2; not measured performance.
